purpose: Document the benchmark-viewer data validation gate for PTO Qwen full-serving result records.
rejected_cases: full_serving PTO Qwen row with failed_requests != 0
full_serving PTO Qwen row with checked_token_count below batch_size * decode_tokens

contract.token_accounting: total_input_tokens == batch_size * prompt_tokens and total_output_tokens == batch_size * decode_tokens
contract.correctness: full_qwen_numerical_correctness with token_match=true and checked_token_count covering generated decode tokens
